enchantments.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Slowburst: This weapon has an image of a snail worked into its hilt or grip, and it feels cold to the touch. Whenever you score a critical hit with this weapon, the target is slowed for 30 seconds. A DC 15 Will save negates this effect.

Entangling Yarn: Enemies struck by this weapon have a small chance to be tangled up in its enchanted yarn, becoming Entangled and preventing all movement for 9 seconds. A DC 35 Reflex Save negates this effect.
Impactful 2: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to ripple with force, dealing 2 to 12 force on each hit.
Bludgeoning 2: The edges of this weapon are blunted, dealing an additional 2d6 bludgeon damage on each hit.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
